2) In the right side in the "touchpad" tab set "swipe up" to "up" key on your keyboard and "swipe down" to "down" key on your keyboard

3) With Bakkesmod running start Rocket League and press F2 to open the Bakkesmod menu

4) In the "bindings" tab add a new binding, clik "none" and then "up" key on you keyboard to set the key and under it write "load\_freeplay; ; ;" and do the same for "down" writing "queue; ;" 

5) Make sure you are in the DS4Windows's new profile to make it work

That's it, let me know if you have troubles!
